reconstructed_theorem_text: Let Omega be a measurable space, S a compact, pseudometrizable, second-countable topological space equipped with its Borel measurable structure, F a filtration on Omega indexed by nonnegative real time, and mu a finite measure on Omega. Let X:[0,infinity) x Omega -> S be jointly measurable and strongly progressive for F. Let c:[0,infinity) x S -> R be continuous. For every T in [0,infinity) and every p in [0,infinity], put b(t,omega)=c(t,X(t,omega)). Then b is strongly progressive for F; for every omega, t -> b(t,omega) is integrable for the measure nu_T=comap(NNReal.toReal, Lebesgue restricted to [0,T]); and (omega,t) -> b(t,omega) belongs to MemLp with exponent p for mu product nu_T.
objects: Measurable sample space Omega; compact pseudometrizable second-countable Borel state space S; filtration F; finite measure mu.
Jointly measurable strongly progressive process X; continuous real coefficient c; composed process b(t,omega)=c(t,X(t,omega)).
Time measure nu_T=comap(NNReal.toReal, volume.restrict(Icc 0 T)); product measure mu.prod(nu_T); processFunction b(omega,t)=b(t,omega).
domains: Times t,T are NNReal (nonnegative finite real numbers).
X takes values in S; c and b are real-valued.
p ranges over ENNReal, including 0 and infinity.
Strong-progressivity domains at horizon i are the subtype {t:NNReal | t<=i} times Omega, equipped with the time subtype sigma-algebra product F_i.
quantifiers: Universally quantified over all spaces, structures, filtration, finite measures, X, c, horizons T and exponents p satisfying the hypotheses.
Strong progressivity means: for every horizon i, the restricted map (t,omega) -> b(t,omega) is strongly measurable for the product with F_i.
Pathwise integrability is for every omega, not merely mu-almost every omega.
No existential approximation or witness process is asserted.
assumptions: S is compact, pseudometrizable and second-countable; its measurable structure is Borel.
mu is finite, without requiring total mass one or nonzero mass.
X is globally jointly measurable and globally strongly progressive.
No strict positivity assumption on T or restriction p>=1 is present.
conclusion: The composition b is strongly progressive at every nonnegative horizon.
Every sample path b(.,omega) is integrable with respect to nu_T.

The swapped-argument real function processFunction b is MemLp(mu.prod(nu_T),p). For 0<p<infinity this includes finite p-power integral and AE strong measurability; at infinity it includes essential boundedness; at p=0 the standard MemLp convention only requires AE strong measurability.
scopes: The process definition b applies to all nonnegative times, while pathwise integrability and MemLp use the selected horizon T.
Strong progressivity is independent of mu and is a strong-measurability property, not just an almost-everywhere version.
The first input coordinate in Function.uncurry X is time; the first coordinate in processFunction b is omega.
The compactness hypothesis is on all of S. Continuity need not bound c uniformly for all time.
constant_dependencies: There is no numerical constant in the conclusion.
Any bound obtained from continuity on [0,T] x S can depend on c, S and T; no uniform-in-T bound is stated.
The MemLp assertion allows arbitrary given p and finite mu; it does not supply a norm estimate.

semantic_checks.totalized_integrals: No bare totalized integral equality is used; explicit Integrable and MemLp conclusions carry their integrability or seminorm content.
semantic_checks.ae_pointwise_order: Path integrability is forall omega. Strong progressivity is forall horizon i. MemLp uses its standard AE strong-measurability convention.
semantic_checks.pushforwards: No probability-law pushforward occurs. TimeMeasure.upTo is the supplied comap along the embedding NNReal.toReal; processTimeMeasure is exactly mu.prod(nu_T).
semantic_checks.interval_orientation: The time measure is restriction to the closed ordered interval [0,T], pulled back to NNReal; there is no oriented interval integral.
semantic_checks.exponents: p is arbitrary ENNReal, including 0 and infinity; no restriction to L2 or Banach-range p>=1.
semantic_checks.compactness: CompactSpace, PseudoMetrizableSpace and SecondCountableTopology on S are all explicit.
semantic_checks.zero_endpoints: T=0 is allowed and nu_0 is the zero measure; progressivity remains a global assertion.
semantic_checks.absolute_continuity: No path or marginal absolute continuity is asserted.
